core_findings: The eight branch results can be organized into a single provenance/dependency atlas without rewriting any historical branch closure state.
The public evidence supports structural and identity-level interoperability, but no project-wide DIRECT_NUMERIC cross-branch transfer was established.
Every PARTIAL_STRUCTURAL bridge remains causally unresolved; structural upstream/downstream placement does not identify the source of downstream numerical differences.
Public-asset and schema limitations are reproducible scientific boundary conditions: B03 contributes three BLOCKED_PUBLIC_ASSET bridges and B04 contributes two BLOCKED_SCHEMA bridges.
Independent-release replication remains an identity/reproducibility boundary because B07 executed no compatible replication test.
The standard-siren branch contributes bounded public-output-dependence evidence while retaining its 10/12 primary state and its true-H0/causal-bias prohibitions.
The project therefore functions as a reproducible research foundation and dependency/provenance atlas rather than as a new fundamental black-hole-physics discovery.
reopen_policy: Historical branch closure states remain immutable. New public releases or newly compatible schemas require separately frozen extensions, not silent updates.
